contea di ritrovamento: North Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
D/ CRISPVS NOB [CAES] ; R/ CAESARVM NOSTRORVM

Copper alloy coin. Nummus of Crispus (317-326), Vow in Wreath issue of 321-324, Reece period 16, from style of bust (RIC vol. 7 pl. 6 no. 220 [obv]) possibly Arles mint; if so, page 259 no. 230, issue of 321. Obverse description: Bare-shouldered bust laureate right, long neck. Obverse inscription: CRISPVS NOB [CAES]. Reverse description: Vow in wreath over two lines: VOT / V. Reverse inscription: CAESARVM NOSTRORVM. Diameter: 18.2mm, Weight: 2.25gms, die axis: 6
